summary: Frontend-only regression + performance verification of the Razorpay preload/parallelization change in BuyModal.jsx. All 5 requested scenarios PASS on desktop 1920x1080 and the CTA sweep on mobile 390x844, against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://health-guide-52.preview.emergentagent.com). (1) nav-buy opens buy-dialog; hero-buy, pricing-buy and sticky-buy also each open buy-dialog on mobile. (2) PRELOAD CONFIRMED: no script[src*='checkout.razorpay.com'] exists on page load (baseline false); within ~200ms of the modal opening the checkout.js script tag is injected and window.Razorpay becomes defined BEFORE any submit click - verified for all four CTAs. (3) Valid submit (Test QA User / qa.test@example.com / 9876543210) POSTed /api/payment/create-order -> HTTP 200 and the .razorpay-container overlay + api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public iframe rendered in 887ms after the Pay click (previously the script download happened inside this window). Price Summary shows 299 and 'Using as qa.test@example.com' is prefilled. Payment intentionally NOT completed (LIVE keys) - stopped at the overlay. (4) Empty-field submit still shows 'Please fill in your name, email and phone.' toast. (5) buy-input-email computed font-size is still exactly 16px (iOS auto-zoom fix intact). Zero pageerror events originated from the app; only the known harmless Razorpay-iframe console noise.

issues: The 'Kabir from Chennai - Bought the Bundle - just now' social-proof toast sits bottom-left and visually overlaps/obscures the left part of the sticky 'Get ... ₹299' bar. The sticky-buy button is still clickable (test passed with a normal click), but consider raising the sticky bar or offsetting the toast upward on small screens.

action_items: Optional (carried over from iteration_1, still reproducible): Razorpay's own 'Contact details / Enter mobile number' step still appears even though prefill.contact is now normalized to '919876543210' (email prefills fine). If skipping this step matters, try passing '+919876543210' or the bare 10-digit number and confirm against Razorpay docs.
Optional design: avoid the social-proof toast overlapping the mobile sticky CTA bar.
critical_code_review_comments: loadRazorpayScript() has no de-duplication guard: if it is called again before the first script's onload fires (e.g. modal closed and reopened quickly, or payNow racing the useEffect warmup) a second <script> tag is appended. Harmless today because the browser caches it and window.Razorpay is idempotent, but a `document.querySelector("script[src*='checkout.razorpay.com']")` check (resolving on that node's load event) would be cleaner.

payNow still funnels every failure into one generic toast and discards err.response?.data?.detail, which makes live-key/order-creation failures hard to diagnose in production (unchanged from iteration_1).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. One Razorpay order created via /api/payment/create-order with throwaway data (Test QA User / qa.test@example.com / 9876543210); no payment attempted.
test_credentials: Not required; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present in this fork.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CTAs: nav-buy, hero-buy, pricing-buy, sticky-buy. Modal testids: buy-dialog, buy-input-name/email/phone, buy-submit-button. /api/config returns razorpay_enabled=true with LIVE keys - NEVER complete a payment, stop at .razorpay-container. Preload assertion pattern that works: evaluate !!document.querySelector("script[src*='checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js']") right after buy-dialog appears (true within ~200ms) plus typeof window.Razorpay !== 'undefined'. Razorpay iframe emits harmless console errors in headless chromium (fingerprint pixel ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED, unsafe header, accelerometer policy) - filter them.
rca_of_the_issue: Original complaint: slow Razorpay checkout load because checkout.js was only fetched after the Pay click, serialized before the create-order POST. Fix verified in the running build: (a) useEffect on modal open warms the script (script node present ~200ms after open, window.Razorpay defined before submit), (b) payNow runs loadRazorpayScript() and the create-order POST via Promise.all so the (now already-resolved) script promise adds no latency, (c) preconnect/dns-prefetch to checkout.razorpay.com and api.razorpay.com are present in public/index.html lines 10-12. Measured Pay-click -> overlay-visible latency: 887ms, dominated by the create-order round trip and Razorpay's own iframe boot.
